synopsis: CAN appears as a route for injecting radar detections or replaying recorded machine-network traffic in virtual testing [f4545, f13348, f16033]. The glossary describes HIL data injection behind sensor optics or antennas, while its broader data-injection description also includes restbus models of the remaining network [f13348, f16033]. Chapter 6 identifies a fidelity trade-off: over-the-air radar emulation retains far more of the production radar than feeding point detections onto CAN or Ethernet [f4545].

relations.note: Both describe sensor-path data injection using camera data, radar detections, and recorded machine-network traffic.
Adds the production-radar retention trade-off of detection-level injection versus over-the-air emulation.
